newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY PRELIM GDP GROWS 1.5 PCT IN '95 - STAT OFFICE.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY PRELIM GDP GROWS 1.5 PCT IN '95 - STAT OFFICE.

text.p: Hungary's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew by 1.5 percent in 1995 according to preliminary figures, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Friday.
The per capita GDP was 537,000 forints or $4,273, it said in a statement.
KSH did not give a comparative growth rate for the previous year, but earlier this year it said the GDP grew at a rate of 3.0 percent in 1994.
